topic.title: Adding Oxygen Feedback to WebHelp Generated with Oxygen Content Fusion

keywords.indexterm: Adding Oxygen Feedback to WebHelp output
Adding comment system to WebHelp output

body.p: To install Oxygen Feedback in your WebHelp output generated with Oxygen Content Fusion, use this procedure:

ul.li: You must have a licensed version of Oxygen Content Fusion.

ol.li: In the Installation page, choose the Install Feedback in WebHelp output generated with Oxygen Content Fusion option.

Create an XML file (e.g. feedback-install.xml) on disk with the following content:
The file content (with the actual server URL and deployment token) can be copied or downloaded directly from the Oxygen Feedback administration interface (the Version Installation Instructions page).

li.p: Upload the file created in the previous step to your Content Fusion project (for example, in the .contentfusion directory, click Upload file from the contextual menu).

ol.li: Open the DITA project file (.contentfusion/ditaProject.xml) in the text editing mode (click More Edit XML Source in the Content Fusion editor's toolbar).

Add the webhelp.fragment.feedback parameter to your WebHelp deliverable inside the publication element:<param href="feedback-install.xml" name="webhelp.fragment.feedback"/>
Set the parameter value to the path of the XML file created in step 6 that contains the installation fragment.

li.p: Commit the changes in the Content Fusion workspace and build the WebHelp deliverable.

p.note: A pre-built AI Positron prompt is available in the Version Installation Instructions page (when you expand the instructions). You can copy it and paste it into the AI Positron assistant in Content Fusion to complete the setup automatically.
